title: Cyber Cowboy Oracle
description: A stylized figure wearing a white cowboy hat and fringed cape stands centered against a radiant background. The figure's face is obscured by shadow while glowing digital audio visualizers, floating musical notes, chains, and abstract symbols emanate from its chest and shoulders.
prompt: A mysterious cowboy figure viewed from the chest up, wearing a large white cowboy hat with a small crown and broken halo above it. The face is completely shadowed. A white fringed cape drapes over the shoulders. The torso is filled with glowing blue and cyan digital audio equalizer bars, floating musical notes, chains, and abstract symbols. Purple smoke-like clouds emerge from the sides of the head. Bright golden light rays and circular halos emanate from behind the figure against a soft white and pale turquoise background.
